note: Rewritten from the original description of Eutermes hospitalis forma hospitaloides established by Holmgren 1913 (Termitenstudien 4, Kungl. Sv. Vet.-Akad. Handl. 50(2)); the original is in German. The description is very brief (alate unknown, worker not differing from the typical form) and the OCR is badly damaged (measurement labels reduced to strings of garbage, lines broken mid-sentence), so only the 4 values and 3 characters that can be read reliably are given, without guessing; type locality Borneo: Miri Hills (Haviland). The first half of the same source pack contains the alate, soldier and worker descriptions of the typical Termes hospitalis and does not belong to this subspecies; it is not used.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The soldier is very similar to the typical form of Hospitalitermes hospitalis: the nasus slightly longer, the dorsum of the abdomen much darker than the venter. The worker does not differ from the typical form. The alate is unknown.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Very similar to the typical form. Nasus slightly longer. Dorsum of the abdomen much darker than the venter. Measurements: body length about 4 mm; head length (including the nasus) 1.86 mm; head width 1.18 mm; pronotum width 0.65 mm.
